description: This file implements a caching handler class for managing cache retrieval and storage of responses in a machine learning or NLP pipeline, specifically tailored for large language models (LLMs). It handles different cache types (Redis, S3, etc.), supports both sync and async operations, and manages caching logic for various response types such as embeddings, completions, transcriptions, and rerankings.

classes.name: CachingHandlerResponse
classes.description: A response object representing the result of cache retrieval, including cached data, embedding cache hit status, and other cache-related info.

classes.name: LLMCachingHandler
classes.description: A handler class that manages cache retrieval and storage for different response types in a system interacting with large language models, supporting async and sync operations, cache hit/miss logging, and response processing.
